description: Detect which symbols changed between two commits by comparing file content hashes.

from_commit.description: Base commit: a SHA (>= 7 hex), branch, tag, major version (17, 9.6), <ref>~N, or a commit_id from another tool, or a commit URL (gitweb, git.postgresql.org, GitHub, pg.ddx.io).

repository.description: Repository name, e.g. pgbouncer. Defaults to postgres when omitted. Aliases: repo, repo_name.

to_commit.description: Target commit: a SHA (>= 7 hex), branch, tag, major version (17, 9.6), <ref>~N, or a commit_id from another tool, or a commit URL (gitweb, git.postgresql.org, GitHub, pg.ddx.io). Default HEAD.

name: detect_changes
